commit f84f799826a4a31fdacbab92ea446f001c40264a
Author: Kevin Galligan <kgalligan@gmail.com>
Date:   Fri Oct 30 15:21:17 2026 -0400

    Typing in the editor window is focus-averse (spec §11 K-4)
    
    A text field took the keys and kept them: Return committed and AppKit
    re-selected the field, and a click on the timeline (which refuses first
    responder) left the field editor attached, both behind no focus ring, so
    the next Space was typed into the field instead of playing.
    
    EditorWindow.sendEvent now asks TextFocus before dispatch: a mouse-down
    outside the text being typed in, Tab or ⇧Tab (unless Full Keyboard Access
    is on, K-1's exception), and Return or keypad Enter in a one-line field
    hand first responder to the content view. Each field commits through its
